values.description: Origin header sent with customer auth requests — must match FRONTEND_URL / TRUSTED_ORIGINS on the server

Phone number used for Sign-Up (Phone OTP) and Sign-In (Phone OTP). Must be a valid Indian number: 10 digits bare (9876543210) or with +91 prefix (+919876543210). Change between runs if you want a fresh account.
Email used for Sign-In (Email OTP). Must already be attached to an existing user in the database (set via Compass until the profile API is built).
Paste the OTP here after copying it from the server console log. Used by both Phone OTP verify and Email OTP sign-in requests.
Auto-set by the Verify OTP (creates account) test script. Used by Sign-In requests to assert the same user is returned, not a new duplicate.
Product variant ID for Cart tests. Get a valid ID from the admin product list.
Product ID for Wishlist tests. Get a valid ID from the admin product list.
